en.text: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你帮助，因虔诚人断绝了；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你幫助，因虔誠人斷絕了；

en.text: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

zhSimplified.text: 凡油滑的嘴唇和夸大的舌头，

zhTraditional.text: 凡油滑的嘴唇和誇大的舌頭，

en.text: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

zhSimplified.text: 他们曾说：我们必能以舌头得胜；

zhTraditional.text: 他們曾說：我們必能以舌頭得勝；

en.text: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, will now arise,” says the LORD; will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华说：因为困苦人的冤屈

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華說：因為困苦人的冤屈

en.text: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的言语是纯净的言语，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的言語是純淨的言語，

en.text: You will keep them, LORD. will preserve them from this generation forever.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你必保护他们；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你必保護他們；

en.text: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
